strings.TooltipInput: Choose the microphone or audio interface used to detect notes.
strings.TooltipGate: The minimum input level before note detection begins.
strings.TooltipHarmonics: Correct common octave errors caused by strong harmonics.
strings.TooltipMic: Start or stop listening through the selected input.
strings.TooltipDeviation: Show how many cents sharp or flat the detected note is.
strings.TooltipTheme: Choose an appearance or let the system decide.
strings.TooltipNotation: Choose letter names or solfège note names.
strings.TooltipLanguage: Choose the language used throughout the app.
strings.MenuTagline: Build confident note recognition, one clean note at a time.
strings.TeacherDescription: Place a target on the staff, then find it on your bass.
strings.StudentDescription: Get a random target and build fast, accurate recognition.
strings.TeacherStart: Click the staff to place a note, or press Random.
strings.TooltipShowLabels: Show the note name beside the staff.
strings.TooltipAccidentalsStudent: Include sharp and flat notes in practice.
strings.TooltipAccidentalsTeacher: Allow accidentals in addition to natural notes.
strings.TooltipOctave: Require the played note to be in the target octave.
strings.TooltipReveal: Show the correct fret in green after a wrong note.
strings.TooltipAutoNext: Show the next target automatically after a correct answer.
strings.TooltipDelay: How long to keep a correct answer visible.
strings.TooltipNotes: Choose which notes can appear as targets.
strings.CorrectStudentNext: Correct! You played {0}. Next note in {1}s...
strings.FindOnBass: Find this note on your bass.
strings.PlayThisNote: Play this note on your bass.
strings.TooltipCoachRandom: Pick notes with the original random generator. Notes can repeat.
strings.TooltipCoachGentle: Play each enabled pitch class once per round. Notes you miss and then play correctly move earlier in the next round. Speed and skips do not count.
strings.TooltipCoachAdaptive: Revisit harder notes more often based on mistakes, response time, and skips.
strings.TooltipCoachShuffle: Play each enabled pitch class once per round in a shuffled order. Results do not affect the order.
